blocks.content: The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet is chaired by the Prime Minister and decides all top-level administrative and institutional appointments.

rows: Progress of government business in Parliament

items: Always remember that the Prime Minister chairs the ACC, whereas the Cabinet Committee on Parliamentary Affairs is chaired by the Home Minister.
Cabinet Committees are extra-constitutional in nature; they are not explicitly mentioned in the Constitution of India.
Proposals for appointments originate from the respective ministries but require final approval from the ACC.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC) is chaired by the Prime Minister of India.
The Minister of Home Affairs serves as the other principal member of this committee.
It makes final decisions on top-level appointments in the Central Secretariat, Public Sector Undertakings, Financial Institutions, and the Reserve Bank of India.
Cabinet Committees are extra-constitutional bodies created under the Government of India Transaction of Business Rules, 1961.
